description: D38 six authored synthetic CORE repair tasks; expected outputs stay in the trusted host evaluator and are frozen before actual inference.

tasks.requirements: Repair solve(a, b) to perform exact Python integer floor division for nonzero integer b, including negative and large integers. Preserve its public signature.
Repair solve(values) to remove duplicate integer values while preserving their first-occurrence order. Return a list and handle empty input.
Repair solve(text) to return a boolean palindrome check after Unicode casefold and removal of all whitespace. Empty normalized text is a palindrome.
tasks.source:
"""Check normalized text symmetry."""
def solve(text):
    """Return whether normalized text reads equally in both directions."""
    return text == text[::-1]

tasks.requirements: Repair solve(text) to count whitespace-separated words after Unicode casefold. Preserve punctuation as part of each word, omit empty tokens and return a dictionary of integer counts.
Repair solve(values, width) to return sums of every contiguous window. Return an empty list if width is nonpositive or exceeds the input length. Include the final valid window.
tasks.source:
"""Summarize adjacent integer windows."""
def solve(values, width):
    """Return all intended contiguous window sums."""
    return [sum(values[index:index + width]) for index in range(len(values) - width)]

tasks.requirements: Repair solve(value, low, high) to clamp integer value to the inclusive interval low through high, where low is at most high. Preserve exact integers.
